objective: Attribute any forward improvement separately to baseline eligibility, paired-book validity, and residual magnitude before crediting the registered coherence rule or changing it.

source_evidence.population: 24 BTC candle markets; 6,465 valid full-window paired states and 1,403 valid registered-interval states
source_evidence.result: zero registered residual rejections; all 735 invalid full-window states failed valid-top checks

source_evidence.population: 100 current non-candle binary markets across five public batch rounds; 490 valid paired states
source_evidence.result: zero registered residual rejections and zero rejections at the fixed 0.002 robustness threshold

registered_comparators.name: baseline_primary_low_edge
registered_comparators.purpose: measure the unpaired baseline candidate pool

registered_comparators.name: paired_book_validity_only
registered_comparators.rule: baseline_primary_low_edge && valid market tick && both book ages in [0, 30000] ms && paired microstructure recomputes from valid top-three books
registered_comparators.purpose: measure candidate and loss removal attributable to having an admissible paired book

registered_comparators.name: frozen_residual_rule
registered_comparators.purpose: measure incremental selectivity attributable only to residual magnitude

registered_outputs.reporting_rule: Report zero counts explicitly; do not replace them with ratios having a zero denominator.

evaluation_sequence: Do not run the labeled attribution until sealed block 1 reaches exactly 750 admissible candidates and the parent preregistration permits one scoring pass.
Score all three comparators on the identical sealed rows with identical fees, fills, latency assumptions, and terminal labels.
If block 1 passes its parent gates, repeat the same frozen attribution on the disjoint 750-candidate block 2.
Do not search residual multipliers, book-age limits, depth levels, candidate intervals, or edge thresholds in either block.

serialized_output_mapping.candidate_count_and_selected_count: attribution.<comparator>.candidates; each comparator's candidate is its selected row for that condition

tests.frozen_fixture: The schema-6 attribution reproduces the schema-5 selected counts, gates, and unit economics while separating baseline, paired-validity, and residual comparators.
tests.inert_residual_fixture: A coherent paired book that makes every residual pass produces zero residual candidate removals, loss removals, and decision disagreements.

linux_measurement_binary.reason: The forward block remains sealed and below its fixed floor; avoid a nonessential release build on the two-core shared VPS. Build a separately hash-pinned schema-6 measurement binary only when scoring is authorized.

decision_rules.zero_residual_disagreements_in_both_bloc: Classify residual magnitude as an integrity assertion with no demonstrated alpha selectivity. Do not credit it for PnL or loss removal. Any code removal still requires paired-book fault-injection coverage and exact replay parity.
decision_rules.nonzero_residual_disagreements: Retain the frozen clause for analysis and report its exact candidate/loss/PnL contribution. Do not tune it on the observed blocks.
decision_rules.paired_validity_improves_losses_or_pnl: Attribute the effect to paired-book admissibility, not residual magnitude, and require the existing support and economic gates to remain satisfied.
decision_rules.any_parent_gate_failure: Reject promotion regardless of ablation results.
